example.title: Ritz-Carlton Marina del Rey (1990), 4375 Admiralty Way
example.place: Marina del Rey, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A 1990 marina-front hotel: a twelve-storey L-shaped tower of pale grey-white precast concrete with a regular grid of windows, a two-storey colonnaded porte-cochère base with square columns, a lawn and pool terrace of palms, cabanas and loungers facing a basin of yachts. Three photos. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
label: Neptune Plaza
